findings.evidence: Tarski.lean:12-20: `/-! # Sturm–Tarski over an arbitrary real closed ordered field` then `## References` on the next line; every other new file (e.g. Signs.lean:11-15, Local.lean:10-16, Sum.lean:11-16) has a body.
findings.fix: Insert a body paragraph between the heading and `## References` saying what the file contains (the Tarski seed condition relating the second chain entry to `f * p'` modulo `p`, the sign-sum identity on an open interval for a signed chain, and its specialisation to `Polynomial.sturmSeq`) and what it feeds; drop the proof-strategy clause from the References block.
findings.issue: Module docstring has no body: line 12 is the heading and line 13 is `## References`. The 247-line file introducing `IsTarskiSeed`, `tarski`, `tarski_squarefree`, `tarski_sturmSeq` and `sturm` never says what material lives there. The one descriptive sentence (lines 17-19) is proof narrative ("the proof sums local variation jumps after removing the common polynomial factor") and sits under the References heading.

findings.evidence: Signs.lean:176-186: `theorem signVariationsAt_eq (cs) (a r : R) (hne ...) (hfront ...) (hlast ...) (halt ...) (hsame ...) : signVariationsAt cs a = signVariationsAt cs r`.
findings.fix: State it: the variation count at `a` equals the count at `r` when no entry vanishes at `a`, the first and last entries do not vanish at `r`, each entry vanishing at `r` has nonvanishing opposite-sign neighbours there, and every entry nonvanishing at `r` has the same sign at `a`.
findings.issue: `signVariationsAt_eq` is documented "Interior zero entries may be erased without changing variations", but the statement erases nothing: it is `signVariationsAt cs a = signVariationsAt cs r` under five hypotheses comparing evaluations at two points. This is the file's main public export (used by Local.lean and Sum.lean); its docstring describes the internal `SignRelation` fact, not the theorem.

findings.evidence: SignVariations.lean:38-42; the only import is `Mathlib.Data.List.SignVariations`, and `signVariationsAt` is defined at Sturm/Signs.lean:83.
findings.fix: Replace with "adds one sign variation exactly when its sign is opposite `firstSign l`".
findings.issue: `signVariations_cons_of_ne_zero`'s docstring reads "adds one signVariationsAt exactly when ..." — a rename artifact. `signVariationsAt` is `TauCeti.Sturm.signVariationsAt`, a declaration this file neither defines nor imports; the sentence is about `List.signVariations` counting one extra sign variation.

findings.evidence: Sign.lean:44-50: `theorem signs_at_root (p : R[X]) {a r b : R} ...` under `namespace Polynomial` with no chain hypothesis in the file.
findings.fix: Say "the polynomial" (or name `p`): across a simple root `r` isolated in `[a, b]`, `sign (p.eval a) = -sign (p.derivative.eval r)` and `sign (p.eval b) = sign (p.derivative.eval r)`.
findings.issue: `signs_at_root` is documented as being about "the head polynomial", but this is a general lemma in the `Polynomial` namespace about an arbitrary `p`; there is no chain and hence no head. Sturm-chain vocabulary copied in without adapting.

summary: Prior findings are fixed, but Tarski.lean — the file holding IsTarskiSeed and the main `tarski` theorem — still has no module docstring body: the heading is followed immediately by `## References`, and its only descriptive sentence is about the proof. Three declaration docstrings also fail to describe their statements.
